visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with an extreme close-up of a patient's eye and eyebrow area. A medical professional, wearing white gloves, holds a clear, circular plastic applicator against the skin. A red laser pointer flashes rhythmically inside the circle, targeting the lower eyelid skin. The skin appears slightly reddened and textured as the laser pulses. A clinic logo and a title overlay are present at the top. (2) The camera zooms out slightly to a medium close-up, revealing a female doctor wearing glasses, a white mask, and a head-mounted magnifying lamp. She is actively performing the laser treatment with a blue handheld device. The background shows a professional clinical setting with soft ambient lighting and medical equipment. (3) A split-screen comparison appears, showing two close-ups of an eye area. The top frame shows more visible fine lines and wrinkles (the 'before' state), while the bottom frame shows smoother skin (the 'after' state). Text overlays highlight the reduction of fine lines. (4) The final scene transitions to a white graphic background featuring the clinic's logo and contact information, including a LINE handle, phone number, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese text. The framing is centered and static.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a series of rhythmic, sharp 'clicks' representing the laser firing, paired with an upbeat electronic synth background music featuring a steady 4/4 beat. A professional female voice begins narrating clearly with a friendly, helpful tone. (2) Each time the laser pulses, a transient mechanical 'snap' sound occurs, which is high-frequency and very short in duration. The background music remains constant in volume and tempo. An interviewer's voice is heard asking a brief question about hyperpigmentation. (3) The doctor responds with a confident, slightly higher-pitched tone, emphasizing the safety and results of the treatment. The 'click' sounds of the laser are audible intermittently as the conversation continues. (4) The narration concludes as the music slightly swells in high-frequency energy before coming to a clean end. There are no distracting ambient noises, suggesting a controlled studio or professional recording environment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Procedure Demonstration -> Expert Explanation -> Result Proof -> Contact Information
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specific medical laser treatment (UP Laser) for skin tightening and wrinkle reduction around the eyes. It addresses a common patient concern (hyperpigmentation/post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation) through expert testimony and demonstrates visible results using a before-and-after comparison.
